_readme: Starter set. Replace or extend with your own real tasks until you have 25-30. Check types: contains_all, contains_any, not_contains, regex, json_keys, max_words. Matching is case-insensitive.

tasks.prompt: Write a two-sentence reply declining a meeting on Friday and offering Monday at 11 am instead.
Summarise in exactly three bullet points: Our Q3 revenue grew 12% to 4.2 crore. Returns fell from 9% to 6% after we changed packaging. We will add two marketplaces in Q4.
Rewrite this to sound professional, keep it under 40 words: 'hey the files r late again, need them by tmrw or we miss the deadline'
Give me a subject line (max 8 words) for an email announcing a price increase of 5% from 1 November.
Extract as JSON with keys name, date, amount: 'Invoice from Kavya Traders dated 3 Oct 2026 for Rs 18,450.' Reply with JSON only.
Classify each line as BUG, FEATURE or QUESTION and reply as JSON mapping the line number to the label: 1) App crashes on login 2) Can you add dark mode? 3) How do I export my data?
Turn this into a Markdown table with columns Task and Owner: Priya does the deck, Arjun books the venue, Meera sends invites.
From this text, list only the dates in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD), one per line, nothing else: 'Kickoff on 5 Nov 2026, review on 19 November 2026, launch 2 Dec 2026.'
Kal subah 9 baje ka reminder banana hai: client ko invoice bhejna. Reply as a single reminder line in the form '- YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM text', assuming today is 2026-10-11.
Mujhe is week ke pending kaam ka short summary chahiye, English mein, 3 bullets: report finish karna hai, Rahul ko call karna hai, GST file karna hai.
Yeh message polite Hindi mein likho (Devanagari): 'Meeting postpone ho gayi hai, nayi date kal bataunga.'
Bhai, 1250 ka 18% GST kitna hoga? Sirf number batao.
